# Aurora X2 Router Manual

The Aurora X2 is a dual-band Wi-Fi router designed for small apartments and home offices.

## Setting up the router

Connect the white WAN cable from your modem to the blue port on the back of the Aurora X2. Plug in the power adapter and wait about two minutes until the status light turns solid green. Open the Aurora app on your phone and follow the setup wizard to choose a network name and password.

## Resetting to factory settings

To reset the router, hold the small recessed reset button on the underside for ten seconds with a paperclip. The status light blinks amber while the router restarts. A factory reset erases your network name, password, and port forwarding rules, so write them down first.

## Firmware updates

The Aurora X2 checks for firmware updates every night at 3 a.m. You can also update manually from the Aurora app by opening Settings and tapping Firmware. Never unplug the router while the light is pulsing purple, because an interrupted update can leave the device unusable.

## Guest network

Enable the guest network in the app under Network, then Guest Access. Guests can reach the internet but cannot see your printers or other devices. The guest network password can be rotated automatically every week.

## Troubleshooting slow Wi-Fi

If the Wi-Fi feels slow, move the router away from microwaves and thick walls and place it high on a shelf. Switch devices that are close to the router to the 5 GHz band. Restart the router once a month to clear memory. If the status light is red, the router cannot reach the internet and you should check the modem cable.
